additionalInformation: This course is open only to Engineering students.
description: This is a seven-week course specially designed for students majoring in Engineering. It introduces the basic concepts in the study of differential equations, with an emphasis on applications in engineering and other fields. Major topics include modelling with differential equations, first-order ordinary differential equations, higher-order linear differential equations, the Laplace transform, and partial differential equations.
